prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1097; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured vehicle was stationary when struck by a third-party vehicle reversing from a parking space. Both drivers exchanged information at the scene. Police report not filed. Liability questions noted for review.

Entry 2: Claimant notified the company that she is represented by counsel. All further contact to be routed through her attorney's office. Claimant's attorney confirmed receipt of acknowledgment letter and requested copies of the policy declarations page and the photos taken at the scene.

Entry 3: Claimant reports neck strain following the collision and has been seen by a treating physician. Medical records requested through counsel. Authorization forms sent to attorney's office for signature. Reserve set pending receipt of records.

Entry 4: Adjuster reviewed scene photographs and repair estimate for the insured vehicle. Damage consistent with rear bumper contact at low speed. Third-party vehicle's insurer contacted to confirm liability position and coverage. Their adjuster indicated the reversing driver accepts responsibility in principle; comparative fault still under discussion.

Entry 5: Attorney's office called to ask about status of the bodily injury evaluation. Advised that records are still outstanding and no settlement position can be taken until treatment history is complete. Follow-up scheduled for next review cycle. File remains open.
